categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in environmental protection water treatment systems and hydrogen fuel cell engine systems. Key product lines include condensate water precision treatment systems, desalinated water treatment (including seawater desalination) systems, sewage treatment systems, and hydrogen fuel cell engine systems. Additionally, the company develops intelligent power station equipment and provides integrated design and system integration services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as high-tower resin separation for condensate water treatment, membrane and thermal coupling seawater desalination technology, and integrated sewage treatment processes. In hydrogen fuel cells, it has developed high-performance membrane electrode assemblies, corrosion-resistant metal bipolar plates, fuel cell stacks, and integrated engine systems with proprietary low-platinum membrane electrode technology, automated stack assembly, and system redundancy control. Production includes modular design, automated assembly lines for fuel cell stacks, and customized equipment manufacturing through collaboration with suppliers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are large-scale industrial enterprises in nuclear power, thermal power, metallurgy, chemical, and municipal sectors. The company serves major national and regional power groups such as China National Nuclear Corporation, China General Nuclear Power Group, State Power Investment Corporation, and others. It also supplies hydrogen fuel cell systems to vehicle manufacturers and participates in overseas markets including South America, Southeast Asia, South Asia, Middle East, and Europe.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant market presence in regions including East China, North China, Northwest China, South China, Southwest China, Northeast China, and Central China. It has expanded overseas since 2010, with projects in countries along the Belt and Road Initiative such as Pakistan, Indonesia, Vietnam, and Brunei.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on research, design, system integration, and assembly of water treatment and hydrogen fuel cell systems. It procures components and collaborates with suppliers for customized equipment manufacturing, while maintaining production lines for core fuel cell components and system assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include consolidating leadership in nuclear and thermal power water treatment markets, expanding hydrogen fuel cell engine system business as a new growth driver, and broadening into non-power industrial water treatment sectors. The company emphasizes R&D in membrane technology, chemical dosing, water sampling, and smart control systems, as well as advanced fuel cell stack and system integration technologies. It actively pursues innovation in green hydrogen production, zero-carbon smart energy stations, and modular, automated manufacturing processes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of water treatment system equipment and hydrogen fuel cell engine systems, including design, procurement, construction, and system integration contracts. The company also earns income from operation and maintenance services under Build-Own-Operate-Transfer (BOOT) models and provides technical services. Sales are primarily project-based, secured through bidding and commercial negotiations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the domestic nuclear and large-scale thermal power condensate water precision treatment market, being one of the few suppliers meeting stringent nuclear power plant requirements. It is recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'little giant' enterprise and a provincial 'hidden champion.' In hydrogen fuel cells, it is among the few with comprehensive in-house capabilities for core components and system integration, competing with other advanced domestic and international players.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 373.8 million, a 46.58% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.54 million, reversing previous losses. Total assets were about RMB 910.7 million, with a slight decrease from the prior year. The company’s R&D investment accounted for 5.21% of revenue. Cash flow from operating activities increased significantly by 625.37%. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with improving profitability and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary technologies and comprehensive system integration capabilities, delivering high-quality, stable, and efficient water treatment solutions tailored for demanding nuclear and thermal power applications. Its hydrogen fuel cell systems feature advanced low-platinum membrane electrode technology, high-performance bipolar plates, and automated assembly, offering superior power density, durability, and environmental adaptability. The company’s modular, automated production and strong R&D foundation enable cost-effective, reliable products that support customers’ green and low-carbon transition goals.
